tei:div.tei:p: sa bcad snang byed sgron me gzhung dang bcas pa bzhugs so// skabs dang po/ rnam mkhyen/ ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zab cing spros pa nyer zhi ba// 'phags gsum smin byed rgyal ba kun// skyed mdzad rten cing 'brel 'byung ba// rgyal yum khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'di la gnyis te/ lo tsā bas smos pa'i mtshan/ gzhung dngos so// dang po lo tsā bas smos pa'i mtshan ni/ rgya gar skad du/ (rgya gar skad du/1 a bhi sa ma ya a laṃ kā ra nā ma pradzñā pā ra mi to u pa de sha shā s+t+ra kā ri kā/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//) zhes pa'o// gnyis pa gzhung dngos la gsum/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung dang*/ mjug gyi don bsdus rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa'o/ /dang po klad kyi don la gnyis/ mkhyen pa gsum gyis 'phags bzhi bskyed pa'i sgo nas mchod par brjod pa dang*/ dgos 'brel dgos pa'o/ /dang po mkhyen pa gsum gyis 'phags bzhi bskyed pa'i sgo nas mchod par brjod pa ni/ nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir 'khrid mdzad gang yin dang*// 'gro la phan par byed rnams lam shes nyid kyis 'jig rten don sgrub mdzad pa gang*// gang dang yang dag ldan pas thub rnams rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa// nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshoḍa bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de la phyag 'tshal// 1 zhes pa'o// gnyis pa dgos 'brel dgos pa la bzhi/ brjod bya dang*/ 'brel ba dang*/ dgos pa dang*/ nying dgos so/ /dang po brjod bya ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes so// gnyis pa 'brel ba ni/ ston pas 'di rnams bshad pa gang*// gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te// chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi//

2 mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas// zhes so// gsum pa dgos pa ni/ blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir// zhes so// bzhi pa nying dgos ni/ bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes// bya ba rtsam pa'i dgos pa yin// 3 zhes pa'o// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ mdor bstan lus rnam gzhag dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po mdor bstan lus rnam bzhag la gnyis/ mdor bstan skabs brgyad dang*/ rgyas bshad don bdun cu'i ming bstan pa'o/ /dang po mdor bstan skabs brgyad ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid// de nas thams cad shes pa nyid// 4 rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang*// rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa// skad cig gcig mngon rdzoḍa byang chub// chos kyi sku dang de rnam brgyad// 5 ces so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad don bdun cu'i ming bstan pa la brgyad de/ rnam mkhyen/ lam shes/ gzhi shes/ rnam kun/ rtse mo/ mthar gyis pa/ skad cig ma/ chos sku rnam dbye dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po rnam mkhyen ni/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*// nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang*// sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*// 6 dmigs pa dag dang ched dang ni// go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*// tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams// thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid// 7 ces so// gnyis pa lam shes ni/ mog mog por byed la sogs dang*// slob ma bse ru'i lam gang dang*// 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyis// phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// 8 byed pa dang ni mos pa dang*// bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa dang*// bsngo dang rjes su yi rang ba// yid la byed pa bla med dag/ 9 sgrub dang shin tu dag pa zhes// bya ba 'di ni sgom pa'i lam// byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi// lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad// 10 ces so// gsum pa gzhi shes ni/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*//

snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang*// thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*// thabs kyis ring ba ma yin nyid// 11 mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag dang*// sbyor dang de yi mnyam nyid dang*// nyan thos la sogs mthong ba'i lam// de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// 12 ces so// bzhi pa rnam kun ni/ rnam pa sbyor bar bcas rnams dang*// yon tan skyon ni mtshan nyid bcas// thar dang nges 'byed cha mthun dang*// slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// 13 srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid dang*// zhing dag bla na med pa ni// rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa ste// 'di ni thabs mkhas bcas pa yin// 14 ces so// lnga pa rtse mo ni/ de yi rtags dang rnam 'phel dang*// brtan dang sems kun gnas pa dang*// mthong zhes bya dang sgom pa zhes// bya ba'i lam ni so so la// 15 rnam par rtog pa rnam bzhi yi// gnyen po rnam pa bzhi dang ni// bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin// log par sgrub dang bcas pa ni// 16 rtse mo'i mngon rtogs zhes so// drug pa mthar gyis pa ni/ mthar gyis pa// rnam gsum rnam bcu zhes so// bdun pa skad cig ma ni/ skad cig ma// gcig gis mngon rdzogs byang chub pa// mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi// 17 zhes so// brgyad pa chos sku rnam dbye dang bcas pa ni/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang*// de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni// chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa// rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod// 18 ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ yul mkhyen pa gsum/ thabs sbyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu chos sku'o/ /dang po yul mkhyen gsum la gsum ste/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ lam gyi gzhi lam shes*/ lam gyi yan lag gol sa dang bcas pa'i gzhi shes bshad pa'o// dang po rnam mkhyen la bdun te/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ gdams ngag dang*/

nges 'byed sbyor lam dang*/ bsgrub pa'i rten rigs 'gal dang bcas pa dang*/ bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa bcu gcig /ched du bya ba/ bsgrub pa'i ngo bo'o// dang po sems bskyed la gsum ste/ sems bskyed kyi ngo bo/ mdo dang sbyar ba/ sa mtshams dbye ba'o/ /dang po sems bskyed kyi ngo bo ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces so// gnyis pa mdo dang sbyar ba ni/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du// bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod// 19 ces so// gsum pa sa mtshams dbye ba ni/ de yang sa gser zla ba me// gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho// rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang*// yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu// 20 rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che// bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni// sgra brnyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis// rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// 21 zhes so// gnyis pa gdams ngag la brgyad de/ bsgrub pa'i ngo bo/ dmigs pa'i yul/ rten/ mi mthun phyogs spang ba'i rgyu gsum/ dring mi 'jog pa spyan lnga/ khyad par can dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mngon shes/ rnam par dag pa mthong bsgom la gdams pa/ khyad par du dge 'dun bstan pa'o/ / dang po bsgrub pa'i ngo bo ni/ sgrub dang zhes so// gnyis pa dmigs pa'i yul ni/ bden pa rnams dang ni// zhes so// gsum pa rten ni/ sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum// zhes so// bzhi pa mi mthun phyogs spang ba'i rgyu gsum ni/ ma zhen yongs su mi ngal dang*// lam ni yongs su 'dzin pa dang*// 22 zhes so// lnga pa dring m-i 'jog pa spyan lnga ni/ spyan lnga dang ni zhes so// drug pa khyad par can dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mngon shes ni/ mngon shes kyi/ yon tan drug dang zhes so// bdun pa rnam par dag pa mthong bsgom la gdams pa ni/

mthong lam dang*// sgom zhes bya la gdams ngag ni// bcu yi bdag nyid shes par bya// zhes so// brgyad pa khyad par du dge 'dun bstan pa ni/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dang*// dad dang mthong thob rigs nas rigs// bar chad gcig par skyes nas dang*// byed dang byed min 'og min 'gro/ 24 'phar gsum srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro/ gzugs kyi chags bcom mthong ba yi// chos la zhi lus mngon sum byed// bse ru dang ni nyi shu'o// 25 zhes so// gsum pa nges 'byed sbyor lam la brgyad de/ nges 'byed mdor bstan pa dang*/ drod kyi dmigs rnam/ rtse mo'i/ bzod pa'i/ chos mchog gi dmigs rnam che 'bring chung ngu gsum gsum dang*/ mdo rgyas kyis gzung rtog dang*/ 'dzin rtog bstan pa dang*/ yongs 'dzin la gdams pa'o/ /dang po nges 'byed mdor bstan pa ni/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*// sgyu dang yongs su 'dzin pa yis// byang chub sems dpa' skyob pa yi// drod sogs bdag nyid ji bzhin du// 26 rnam rtog bzhi po ldan brten pa// chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams// nyan thos bse ru lta bu dang*// bcas pa dag las khyad par 'phags// 27 zhes so// gnyis pa drod kyi dmigs rnam che 'bring chung gsum ni/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa// bden pa'i rten can de yi ni// rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gog/ theg pa gsum char 'thob pa'i rgyu// 28 gzugs sogs 'du 'god gnas bral dang*// gnas dang brtags dang brjod du med// ces so// gsum pa rtse mo'i dmigs rnam chung 'bring che gsum ni/ gzugs sogs mi gnas de dag ni// de yi ngo bo rang bzhin med// 29 de dag gcig gi rang bzhin gcig/ de mi rtag sogs par mi gnas// de rnams de yi ngo bos stong*// de dag gcig gi rang bzhin gcig/ 30 chos rnams mi 'dzin gang yin dang*// de dag mtshan mar mi mthong phyir// shes rab kyis ni yongs rtogs pa//

thams cad dmigs su med par ro// 31 zhes so// bzhi pa bzod pa'i dmigs rnam chung 'bring che gsum ni/ gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med nyid// de med pa nyid ngo bo nyid// de dag skye med nges 'byung med// dag dang de dag mtshan ma med// 32 de yi mtshan mar mi brten pas// mos min 'du shes med pa yin// zhes so// lnga pa chos mchog gi dmigs rnam chung 'bring che gsum ni/ ting 'dzin de yi byed pa nyid// lung ston pa dang rlom pa zad// 33 gsum po phan tshun ngo bo gcig/ ting 'dzin rnam par mi rtog pa// de ltar nges 'byed cha mthun ni// chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin// 34 zhes so// drug pa mdo rgyas kyis gzung rtog bstan pa ni/ gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yis// gzung bar rtog pa rnam pa gnyis// rmongs dang phung sogs bye brag gis// de ni so sor rnam pa dgu/ 35 zhes so// bdun pa mdo rgyas kyis 'dzin rtog bstan pa ni/ rdzas dang brtags pa'i rten can gyis// 'dzin pa'ang rnam pa gnyis su 'dod// rang dbang bdag sogs ngo bo dang*// phung sogs rten las de bzhin no// 36 zhes so// brgyad pa yongs 'dzin bstan pa ni/ sems mi 'gong ba nyid la sogs// ngo bo nyid med sogs ston byed// de yi mi mthun phyogs bor ba// rnam pa kun tu yongs 'dzin yin// 37 zhes so// bzhi pa bsgrub pa'i rten rigs 'gal dang bcas pa ni/ rtogs pa yi ni chos drug dang*// gnyen po dang ni spong ba dang*// de dag yongs su gtugs pa dang*// shes rab snying brtser bcas pa dang*// 38 slob ma thun mong min nyid dang*// gzhan gyi don gyi go rims dang*// ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar// 'jug pa'i rten la rigs shes bya// 39 zhes dang*/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin// rten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis// de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod// 40 ces so// lnga pa bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa bcu gcig ni/

dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de// de yang dge la sogs pa yin// 'jig rten pa yi rtogs pa dang*// gang dag 'jig rten 'das 'dod dang*// 41 zag bcas zag pa med chos dang*// gang dag 'dus byas 'dus ma byas// slob ma thun mong chos rnams dang*// gang dag thub pa'i thun mong min// 42 zhes so// drug pa bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba ni/ sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang*// spangs dang rtogs dang gsum po la// chen po gsum gyi rang byung gi/ ched du bya ba 'di shes bya// 43 zhes so// bdun pa bsgrub pa'i ngo bo la drug te/ go cha brtson 'grus kyi bsgrub pa dang*/ 'jug pa rnam pa dgu dang*/ tshogs bcu bdun bsgrub pa dang*/ bye brag tu sa'i tshogs dang*/ gnyen po rnam pa brgyad kyi tshogs dang*/ nges 'byung bsgrub pa brgyad do/ /dang po go cha brtson 'grus kyi bsgrub pa ni/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs// rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis// go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin de// drug tshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad// 44 ces so// gnyis pa 'jug pa rnam pa dgu ni/ bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin sogs dang*// lam dang byams la sogs pa dang*// dmigs pa med dang ldan pa dang*// 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa dang*// 45 ched du bya dang mngon shes drug/ rnam kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la ni// 'jug pa'i sgrub pa theg chen la// 'dzegs pa yin par shes par bya// 46 ces so// gsum pa tshogs bsgrub bcu bdun ni/ brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug/ zhi gnas lhag mthong bcas pa dang*// zung du 'brel pa'i lam gang dang*// thabs la mkhas pa gang yin dang*// 47 ye shes dang ni bsod nams dang*// lam dang gzungs dang sa bcu dang*// gnyen po tshogs kyi sgrub pa yi// rim pa yin par shes par bya// 48 zhes so// bzhi pa sa'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa la bcu ste/ sa dang po'i yongs su sbyang ba bcu dang*/ gnyis pa'i brgyad/ gsum pa'i lnga dang*/ bzhi pa'i bcu dang*/

lnga pa'i bcu dang*/ drug pa'i bcu gnyis dang*/ bdun pa'i nyi shu spang ba dang*/ sbyang ba dang*/ brgyad pa'i brgyad/ dgu pa'i bcu gnyis dang*/ bcu pa bstan pa'o// dang po sa dang po'i yongs sbyong bcu ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis// sa ni dang po 'thob 'gyur te// bsam dang phan pa'i dngos nyid dang*// sems can rnams la sems mnyam nyid// 49 gtong dang bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*// dam chos dmigs pa tshol ba dang*// rtag tu nges 'byung sems nyid dang*// sangs rgyas skur 'dod dga' ba dang*// 50 chos ston pa dang bden pa yi// tshig ni bcu pa yin par 'dod// 'di dag rang bzhin mi dmigs pas// yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya// 51 zhes so// gnyis pa'i brgyad ni/ tshul khrims byas pa gzo dang bzod// rab tu dga' dang snying brtse che// bkur sti bla ma la gus nyan// brgyad pa sbyin la sogs la brtson// 52 zhes so// gsum pa'i lnga ni/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni// zang zing med par chos sbyin dang*// sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong ba dang*// 'khor bas yongs su mi skyo dang*// 53

ngo tsha khrel yod ces bya ba// rlom med bdag nyid de rnam lnga// zhes so// bzhi pa'i bcu ni/ nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang*// sbyangs pa yang dag sdom bsten dang*// 54 bslab pa yongs su mi gtong dang*// 'dod pa rnams la smod pa dang*// mya ngan 'das dang bdog kun gtong*// mi zhum pa dang lta ba med// 55 ces so// lnga pa'i bcu ni/ 'dris dang khyim la 'khren pa dang*// 'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas dang ni// bdag bstod gzhan la brnyas pa dang*// mi dge'i las kyi lam bcu dang*// 56 rlom pas khengs dang phyin ci log/ blo ngan dang ni nyon mongs bzod// bcu po 'di ni rnam spangs na// sa lnga pa ni yang dag 'thob// 57 ces so// drug pa'i bcu gnyis ni/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan shes rab rab rdzogs pas// slob ma dang ni bse ru la// dga' dang skrag pa'i sems spangs pa// 58 bslangs na mi zhum bdog pa kun// btang yang mi dga' med pa dang*// dbul yang slong ba mi spong bas// sa ni drug pa yang dag 'thob// 59 ces so// bdun pa'i spang bya nyi shu ni/ bdag dang sems can 'dzin pa dang*// srog dang gang zag chad rtag dang*// mtshan ma rgyu dang phung po dang*// khams dang skye mched dag dang ni// 60 khams gsum po la gnas dang chags// sems ni kun tu zhum pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum dang tshul khrims la// der lta ba yi mngon zhen dang*// 61 stong pa nyid la rtsod pa dang*// de dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ni// nyi shu gang la rnam chad pa// de yis sa ni bdun pa 'thob// 62 ces so// blang bya nyi shu ni/ rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa dang*// 'khor gsum rnam par dag nyid dang*// snying rje dang ni rlom med dang*// chos mnyam nyid dang tshul gcig shes// 63 mi skye ba dang bzod shes dang*// chos rnams rnam pa gcig tu ston// rtog pa kun tu 'joms pa dang*// 'du shes lta dang nyon mongs spong*// 64 zhi gnas nges par sems pa dang*// lhag mthong la ni mkhas pa dang*//

sems dul ba dang thams cad la// thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang*// 65 chags pa'i sa min gar 'dod par// zhing gzhan du ni mnyam 'gro dang*// kun tu bdag gi ngo bo ni// ston pa nyid dang nyi shu'o// 66 zhes so// brgyad pa'i brgyad ni/ sems can kun yid shes pa dang*// mngon par shes pas brtse ba dang*// sangs rgyas zhing bzang sgrub pa dang*// yongs su brtag phyir sangs rgyas brten// 67 dbang po shes dang rgyal ba yi// zhing sbyong sgyu ma ltar gnas dang*// bsams bzhin srid pa len pa dang*// las ni rnam pa 'di brgyad bshad// 68 ces so// dgu pa'i bcu gnyis ni/ smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang*// lha la sogs pa'i skad shes dang*// spobs pa chu bo lta bu dang*// mngal du 'jug pa mchog dang ni// 69 rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang*// 'khor dang skye ba dag dang ni// nges 'byung byang chub shing rnams dang*// yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin// 70 zhes so// sa bcu pa bstan pa ni/ sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni// gang gis sangs rgyas sar gnas pa// de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa// bcu pa yin par shes par bya// 71 zhes so// lnga pa gnyen po'i tshogs ni/ mthong dang sgom pa'i lam dag la// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnams// nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir// gnyen po rnam pa brgyad ces bya// zhes so// drug pa nges 'byung sgrub pa ni/ ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang*// sems can don dang 'bad med dang*// mtha' las 'das par nges 'byung dang*// thob pa'i mtshan nyid nges 'byung dang*// 73 rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*// lam gyi yul can nges 'byung ste// rnam pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid 'di// nges 'byung sgrub pa yin zhes bya// 74 zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs dang po'o// // skabs gnyis pa/ lam shes/ gnyis pa lam gyi gzhi lam shes la gnyis/ lam shes skye ba'i yan lag dang*/

dngos so/ /dang po lam shes skye ba'i yan lag ni/ lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir// 'od kyis mog mog por mdzad dang*// yul nges pa dang khyab pa dang*// rang bzhin dang ni de yi las// 1 zhes so// gnyis pa lam shes dngos la gsum/ nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'o/ /dang po nyan thos kyi lam la lnga/ lam gyi rang bzhin/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog go/ /dang po lam gyi rang bzhin ni/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni// 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi/ rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni// nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya// 2 zhes so// gnyis pa drod ni/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni// gzugs la sogs pa stong pa'i phyir// stong pa nyid rnams dbyer med pas// dro ba zhes so// gsum pa rtse mo ni/ de dag mi dmigs pas// 3 rtse mor gyur pa dag tu 'dod// zhes so// bzhi pa bzod pa ni/ de la rtag la sogs tshul gyis// gnas pa bkag pas bzod pa rnams// zhes so// lnga pa chos mchog ni/ sa bcu dag las brtsams nas ni// 4 mi gnas rgyas par bstan pa yis// chos kyi mchog tu 'gyur bshad de// ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyis// mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir// 5 zhes so// gnyis pa rang rgyal la bzhi/ nyan thos dang khyad par/ sgra med par chos ston tshul/ lam gyi ngo bo/ sbyor lam nges 'byed bstan pa'o/ /dang po nyan thos dang khyad par bstan pa ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// gzhan gyis bstan yang mi dgos la// bse ru lta bu'i ye shes ni// zab pa nyid du mngon par brjod// 6 ces so// gnyis pa sgra med par chos ston tshul ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la// ji lta ji ltar nyan 'dod pa// de de la don de dang de// sgra med kyang de de ltar snang*// 7 zhes so// gsum pa lam gyi ngo bo ni/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*// 'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni//

rten gyis bse ru lta bu'i lam// yang dag bsdus par shes par bya// 8 zhes so// bzhi pa sbyor lam nges 'byed bstan pa ni/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar// ston pa'i rnam pa dror gyur pa// rtse mor gyur pa gzugs la sogs// 'grib pa med la sogs pas phye// 9 nang stong nyid la sogs pa yis// gzugs sogs mi 'dzin phyir bzod pa// gzugs sogs skye ba med sogs kyi// rnam pa can ni chos kyi mchog/ 10 ces so// gsum pa byang chub sems dpa'i lam la gnyis/ mthong lam khyad par can dang*/ bsgom lam mo/ /dang po mthong lam khyad par can la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan ni/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*// shes pa'i skad cig rnam bzhi yis// lam shes nyid la mthong ba'i lam// phan yon bcas pa 'di bshad do// 11 zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dang*// phan tshun rten pa rten med phyir// rnam grangs khas mi len pa dang*// chen po tshad ma med bcas dang*// 12 tshad med pa dang mtha' med dang*// der gnas gzugs la sogs pa la// sangs rgyas nyid du nges 'dzin dang*// blang med dor ba med sogs dang*// 13 byams la sogs pa stong nyid dang*// sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob pa dang*// rnam par byang kun yongs bsdus dang*// nyam nga ba dang nad kun sel// 14 mya ngan 'das 'dzin zhi nyid dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsrung la sogs// srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa// rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni// 15 bdag nyid gnas te sems can dag/ 'god dang sbyin pa la sogs pa// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba// lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma// 16 zhes so// gnyis pa bsgom lam la gnyis/ bsgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ byed pa can gyi bsgom lam mo/ /dang po bsgom lam gyi byed pa ni/ kun nas zhi dang thams cad la// bdud dang nyon mongs las rgyal dang*// gnod pas brdzi ba med nyid dang*// byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid//

17 ces so// gnyis pa byed pa can gyi bsgom lam la gnyis/ zag bcas dang*/ zag med do/ /dang po zag bcas bsgom lam la bzhi ste/ mos pa bsgom pa dang*/ de la bstod bkur bsngags pa dang*/ bsngo ba dang*/ yi rang ba'o/ / dang po mos pa bsgom pa ni/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni// rang gzhan don dang gzhan don dang*// rnam gsum shes bya de yang ni// chung dang 'bring dang chen po ste// 18 so sor rnam pa gsum du 'dod// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis// de yang rnam gsum de ltar na// rnam pa nyi shu bdun du 'dod// 19 ces so// gnyis pa de la bstod bkur bsngags pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// mos pa'i gnas skabs rnams la ni// dgu tshan gsum gyis bstod pa dang*// bkur ba dang ni bsngags par 'dod// 20 ces so// gsum pa bsngo ba la drug /ngo bo dang*/ rnam pa dang*/ mtshan nyid dang*/ thabs dang 'brel ba dang*/ mi mthun phyogs spang ba dang*/ dbye ba phan yon dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ngo bo ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can// de yi byed pa mchog yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa rnam pa ni/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// 21 zhes so// gsum pa mtshan nyid ni/ phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do// ces so// bzhi pa thabs dang 'brel ba ni/ dben dang sangs rgyas bsod nams tshogs// rang bzhin dran pa'i spyod yul can// thabs bcas mtshan ma med pa dang*// sangs rgyas rjes su yi rang dang*// 22 zhes so// lnga pa mi mthun phyogs spang ba ni/ khams gsum rtogs pa ma yin dang*// zhes so// drug pa dbye ba phan yon dang bcas pa ni/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po yi// bsngo ba gzhan ni rnam gsum po// bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do// 23 ces so// bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis// dge ba'i rtsa la yi rang ba// rjes su yi rang yid byed pa// bsgom pa yin par 'dir brjod do// 24 zhes so// gnyis pa zag med bsgom lam la gsum/ bsgom lam dngos bsgrub pa/

de la mos mi mos kyi rgyu/ rnam dag go /dang po bsgom lam dngos bsgrub pa ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid// kun la mngon par 'du mi byed// chos rnams dmigs su med par ni// gtod par byed pa don chen nyid// 25 ces so// gnyis pa de la mos mi mos kyi rgyu ni/ sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogs dang*// thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa// 'di la mos pa'i rgyu dag yin// chos kyis phongs pa'i rgyu dag ni// 26 bdud kyi thibs kyis non pa dang*// zab mo'i chos la ma mos dang*// phung po la sogs mngon zhen dang*// sdig pa'i groḍa pos yongs zin pa'o// 27 zhes so// gsum pa rnam dag la bzhi ste/ rnam dag spyir bstan/ khyad par bstan pa/ theg dman gyi shin tu dag pa dang*/ theg chen gyi shin tu dag pa'o/ /dang po rnam dag spyir bstan pa ni/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs// dag pa nyid de gang gi phyir// de gnyis tha dad ma yin zhing*// bcad du med pas dag par brjod// 28 ces so// gnyis pa khyad par bstan pa ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi// nyams phyir slob ma bse ru dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi dag pa ste// sangs rgyas rnam kun shin tu ba// 29 zhes so// gsum pa theg dman gyi shin tu dag pa ni/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi// chen po la sogs dri ma yi// gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngu la// sogs pa'i lam ni dag pa yin// 30 zhes so// bzhi pa theg chen gyi shin tu dag pa ni/ de la klan ka spangs pa yis// lam ni 'jal dang gzhal bya dang*// mnyam pa nyid kyis khams gsum gyi// gnyen po nyid du 'dod pa yin// 31 zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs gnyis pa'o// // skabs gsum pa/ gzhi shes/ ༄༅/ /gsum pa lam gyi yan lag gol sa dang bcas pa gzhi shes la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi bsdu ba'o/ /dang po dngos la gsum ste/

gzhi shes kyi rang bzhin/ sbyor ba/ mthong lam mo/ /dang po gzhi shes kyi rang bzhin la bzhi ste/ ngo bo mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa/ mtshan mar 'dzin na ring ba/ thabs mkhas pa nye ba/ byed pa mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'o/ /dang po ngo bo mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa ni/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// de dag bar na mi gnas pa// dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir// shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod// 1 ces so// gnyis pa mtshan mar 'dzin na ring ba ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas// thabs ma yin pas ring ba ste// zhes so// gsum pa thabs mkhas pa nye ba ni/ de ni thabs la mkhas pa yis// yang dag nye ba nyid du bshad// 2 ces so// bzhi pa byed pa mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po la bdun/ gzhi lam mtshan 'dzin spang bya dang*/ de'i gnyen po dang*/ 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin spang byar bshad pa/ gnyen po zab pa'i tshul/ bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po gzhi lam mtshan 'dzin spang bya bstan pa ni/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang*// dus gsum rtogs pa'i chos rnams dang*// sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la// spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs// 3 zhes so// gnyis pa de'i gnyen po ni/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med// gzhan dag de la 'dzud byed pa// de ni chags pa'i mtha' 'gog pas// rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra// 4 zhes so// gsum pa 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin spang byar bshad pa ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis// dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid// ces so// bzhi pa gnyen po ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni// shes pas chags pa spong ba yin// 5 zhes so// lnga pa zab pa'i tshul ni/ mthong ba la sogs bkag pa yis// de ni rtogs par dka' bar bshad// ces so// drug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ gzugs la sogs par mi shes phyir// de ni bsam mi khyab par 'dod// 6 ces so// bdun pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la// mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag gi/

rnam par dbye ba ma lus ba// ji skad bshad pa 'dir shes bya// 7 ces so// gnyis pa sbyor ba'i lam la gnyis te/ rang bzhin dang gegs sel ba dang*/ mnyam pa nyid bsgom pa'o/ /dang po rang bzhin ni/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang*// de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang*// de la chags pa med nyid la// spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*// 8 mi 'gyur byed po med nyid dang*// bya dka' rnam gsum sbyor ba dang*// skal ba ji bzhin 'bras thob pas// 'bras yod 'dod pa de dang ni// 9 gzhan la rag las med gang dang*// snang ba rnam bdun shes byed do// zhes so// gnyis pa mnyam pa nyid bsgom pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med pa// rnam bzhi de yi mnyam pa nyid// 10 ces so// gsum pa mthong lam la gnyis te/ ye shes skad cig ma mdor bstan dang*/ rtogs pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po mdor bstan ni/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la//

chos shes rjes su shes pa dang*// bzod shes skad cig bdag nyid 'di// kun shes tshul la mthong ba'i lam// 11 zhes so// gnyis pa rtogs pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min// mtha' las 'das dang rnam dag dang*// ma skyes ma 'gags la sogs dang*// mkha' 'dra chags pa spangs pa dang*// 12 yongs su 'dzin las grol ba dang*// ngo bo nyid kyis brjod med dang*// gang phyir 'di don brjod pa yis// gzhan la sbyin du med pa dang*// 13 dmigs pa med par byed pa dang*// shin tu rnam dag nad mi 'byung*// ngan song chad dang 'bras bu ni// mngon du bya la mi rtog nyid// 14 mtshan ma dag dang ma 'brel dang*// dngos dang ming dang gnyis po la// shes pa skye ba med pa ni// kun shes nyid kyi skad cig ma// 15 zhes so// gnyis pa mkhyen pa gsum gyi bsdu ba ni/ de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang*// yang 'di yin te rnam gsum po// 'di ni gnas skabs gsum po dag/ rdzogs par yongs su bstan pa yin// 16 zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ skabs gsum pa'o// //
